# Hafiz Abdullah Amjad - Full-Stack Software Engineer & AI Specialist

## Overview
Hafiz Abdullah Amjad is a Full-Stack Software Engineer and AI enthusiast with expertise in architecting scalable web platforms, multi-agent AI ecosystems (LangGraph, PyTorch, RAG), enterprise CRMs, and custom Shopify apps (Shopify Functions, Polaris, GraphQL). BS in Computer Science from University of Management and Technology (CGPA: 3.85).
